scope: Separate Windows pure-read wrapper plus constant-label first-failure diagnostics. Frozen base sleep-plugin-reader manifest and files verified unchanged. No main edits, native calls, memory writes, launch, install or Git.

verification.strict_adapter_object_compile: MSVC x64 C++17 /EHsc /W4 /WX using current main native/include headers

integration.gate: Run CodeGate in existing complete retail PE/SHA gate and Configure with Addresses + gate result. Natural script observer supplies ownerThread and native admitted status. Never Lua arguments.
integration.coherence: Two paired pp::ReadState snapshots, pure plugin snapshots a/b, fresh own scope after, pp::ReadState after, pure plugin snapshot c, final own cache and final pp::ReadState identity and WindowSeq/InBatch/owner recheck. Only publish after all match.
integration.refusals: All stage/reason values static constants. First 32 chain failures log constant component label, relative offset, read length/success, nullable image RVA only, and successful-zero marker. No raw addresses exposed. Pure reader optional const char** refusal receives first grouped stage.
integration.outputs: Reply ready/generation/reason and bodies[2] diagnostic mode/requested/action/qAction/lifeState/nodeState/nodeKind/flags/subtype/recordFlags/counter/nodeActive/callbackInitialized. No pointers, graph claims or mutations.
integration.limits: No natural stock sleep activation, native health/stun wake, horse/carry attach or control changes. Graph loaded/current state and full transitive null-sync census remain separate blockers.
